name: airnobe
description: Windows 中日双语 EPUB 轻小说书库与阅读器

scripts.build: npm run build -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run build -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && npm run build -w @airnobe/furigana && npm run build -w @airnobe/reader-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run build -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run typecheck -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && npm run build -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && npm run typecheck -w @airnobe/furigana && npm run build -w @airnobe/furigana && npm run typecheck -w @airnobe/reader-web
scripts.test: npm run build:guide -w @airnobe/desktop && npm run build -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run test -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run test -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && npm run build -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && npm run test -w @airnobe/furigana && npm run build -w @airnobe/furigana && npm run test -w @airnobe/reader-web
scripts.test:real: npm run build -w @airnobe/book-format && cross-env RUN_REAL_EPUB_TESTS=1 npm run test -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer -- real-epubs
scripts.furigana: npm run build -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run build -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && tsx tools/furigana/src/cli.ts
scripts.reader: npm run build:guide -w @airnobe/desktop && npm run build -w @airnobe/book-format && npm run build -w @airnobe/epub-normalizer && npm run build -w @airnobe/furigana && npm run dev -w @airnobe/reader-web
